items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: The interviewee identifies Lizzie in a group photo of employees at the Matty Grind bar but does not describe a personal or professional relationship beyond her presence there.

ctx.x: Yeah, Tourmalon was with us. He was playing bass, wasn't he? He was playing bass. Well, during that time, I was at the Matty Grind, and this is all the employees here, Joe Robichore. He was playing intermissions. Oh yeah.

Yeah, Joe Robichore and Lindsey Miles. I see, who else? That Lindsey Miles there, there's Joe Robichore sitting beside me at the piano. That one big picture they're taking, all the employees. Let's go from left to right.
